title: Elizondo's idea that UFOs are prepping the battle space
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Elizondo's idea that UFOs are prepping the battle space, about 2017-present at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Lou Alzando has been out for a while now, you know, since 2017. uh he was kind of one of the first whistleblowers and he in the past has said maybe UFOs are sort of prepping the battle space.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who went public about UFOs in 2017 and was one of the first whistleblowers, has suggested that UFOs may be "prepping the battle space", meaning getting the ground ready before a conflict. Michels brings it up because, if true, the objects would be preparing for some kind of confrontation rather than just watching.
